section_summary.extract_value: This Results section reports findings from a multiple linear regression analysis examining predictors of consideration of cosmetic surgery. Body appreciation (BAS), Internalisation-General, Information, BMI, and Pressures emerged as significant predictors, with the model explaining 47.1% of variance (F(7, 314) = 41.89, p < .001). The section references Table 1 for descriptive statistics and correlations among variables including SATAQ-3 subscales, body appreciation, BMI, and age.

section_summary.extract_value: This Results section presents descriptive statistics and inter-item correlations from Table 1, showing that consideration of cosmetic surgery was significantly correlated with SATAQ-3 subscales and negatively correlated with body appreciation, BMI, and age. A multiple linear regression analysis (F(7, 314) = 41.89, p < .001, Adj. R² = .471) identified body appreciation, Internalisation-General, Information, BMI, and Pressures as significant predictors of cosmetic surgery consideration. The study appears to be a single cross-sectional analysis with approximately 322 participants.
